ci_conventions.R4: 95% percentile bootstrap, 10,000 resamples of whole concepts; single subject and fixed image galleries. Each arm contrast keeps rows paired. Deltas are fractions unless a metric names another unit.
ci_conventions.R80: 95% paired percentile bootstrap over official stimulus rows. Deltas are fractions for classification, native units for cosine, correlation and SSIM; tests are unadjusted. Category scoring excludes six unlabeled stimuli.

registered_R4.protocol: Closed 12-way EEG calibration. Five photo-disjoint folds; eight other images of each target class calibrate each fold. Replication uses a disjoint seeded list of 12 classes. Rendered objects also scored against the full dictionary.

color.units: RGB in [0,1]; mean-channel MAE and 32x32 RGB RMSE lower is better; luminance correlation higher is better.

jpeg_rescored_color_object_identity.reference: Archived aligned JPEGs rescored with identical preprocessing

jpeg_rescored_color_object_identity.reference: Archived aligned JPEGs rescored with identical preprocessing

within_predicted_word_and_fold_swap.unit: Original-photo CLIP cosine for own continuous features minus exchanged features. Eligible rows share predicted word and fold; bootstrap samples concepts and weights by eligible rows.

held_concept_R4.protocol: Twenty development and twenty separate confirmation concepts, ten photos each. Confirmation comes from historical V excluding development. Object/photo/within-concept retrieval use 20/200/10 candidates respectively. Image oracle uses target image information.

official_R80.protocol: Official 200 test objects, one photo per object, author-released 80-repeat ATM embeddings. Gallery retrieval, full-vocabulary word prediction and pixel-based reconstruction scores are distinct tasks.
official_R80.encoder_provenance: The ATM authors' public retrieval code monitors official test performance over epochs. The exact epoch of the released feature export is unknown.

collision_check.thresholds: Remove globally for identical SHA or RGB128 thumb SHA, or Hamming pHash63 <=4 AND dHash64 <=6 on any full/center combination.

word_and_continuous.credit: Expected correct count with split boundary ties.

reranked_and_external.credit: Expected correct count with split boundary ties.

ip_adapter.credit: Expected correct count with split boundary ties.

candidate_reranking.selection: Maximum of four frozen scores independently per EEG row. First source wins ties.
